findings: The missense box says the sickle cell change is 'A to T' and the text says 'T is substituted by A' (CTC to CAC); these describe the coding and template strands of the same change. The lesson explains both, flagged.

The silent example 'GGC to GGU' is an mRNA codon change though described as a DNA code. The book says some PKU medicines contain synthetic PAH; the enzyme-substitution drug in use (pegvaliase) is a different enzyme, phenylalanine ammonia lyase. The lesson attributes the statement to the book, flagged.
The point-mutation figure is drawn with the book's own sequence (TAT CAT CCT AAG GTA). The boxes on minor mutations, harmful mutations and treatments are carried.
